title: Insert XOR
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There is an integer sequence $A=(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N)$ of length $N$ consisting of $0$ and $1$. You are given $Q$ queries. The $q$-th query is as follows:

- An integer $i_q$ between $1$ and $N$ is given. Change $A_{i_q}$ to $1$ if it is $0$, and to $0$ if it is $1$.

After processing each query, find the answer to the following problem:

> Consider sequences $B=(B_1,B_2,\dots,B_{|B|})$ consisting of $0$ and $1$ that satisfy the following condition:
> 
> - By performing the following operation any number of times on $B$, it can be made to match sequence $A$:
> - Choose an integer $i$ between $1$ and $|B|-1$, inclusive.
>   - Insert $B_i\oplus B_{i+1}$ between $B_i$ and $B_{i+1}$.
> 
> It can be proved that there always exists a
> 
> B
> 
> that satisfies the condition. Find the minimum possible value of
> 
> |B|
> 
> .

## Constraints

- $3 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5$
- $0 \leq A_i \leq 1$
- $1 \leq Q \leq 5 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq i_q \leq N$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 \dots A_N
Q
i_1
i_2
\vdots
i_Q
```

## Output

Output the answers in a total of $Q$ lines. The $q$-th line should contain the answer to the problem after processing the $q$-th query.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定一个由 $0$ 和 $1$ 组成的、长度为 $N$ 的整数序列 $A=(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N)$。给定 $Q$ 个查询。第 $q$ 个查询如下：

- 给出一个介于 $1$ 和 $N$ 之间的整数 $i_q$。若 $A_{i_q}$ 为 $0$，则将其改为 $1$；若为 $1$，则将其改为 $0$。

在处理每个查询后，求以下问题的答案：

> 考虑由 $0$ 和 $1$ 组成的、满足以下条件的序列 $B=(B_1,B_2,\dots,B_{|B|})$：
> 
> - 通过对 $B$ 执行任意多次以下操作，可以使其变得与序列 $A$ 一致：
> - 选择一个介于 $1$ 与 $|B|-1$ 之间（含两端）的整数 $i$。
>   - 在 $B_i$ 和 $B_{i+1}$ 之间插入 $B_i\oplus B_{i+1}$。
> 
> 可以证明，总是存在满足条件的
> 
> B
> 
> 。求
> 
> |B|
> 
> 的最小可能值。

## 约束条件

- $3 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5$
- $0 \leq A_i \leq 1$
- $1 \leq Q \leq 5 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq i_q \leq N$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入以如下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 A_2 \dots A_N
Q
i_1
i_2
\vdots
i_Q
```

## 输出格式

一共输出 $Q$ 行。第 $q$ 行应包含处理完第 $q$ 个查询后的问题的答案。

samples.note: When $A=(1,0,0)$, $|B|$ is minimized by $B=(1,0,0)$. When $A=(1,1,0)$, $|B|$ is minimized by $B=(1,0)$.
